articles.title: BNCCORP (OTCPK:BNCC) Stock Stalls As Q3 Earnings Rebound Meets Risk Questions
articles.summary: BNCCORP shares barely flinched after Q3 2026 results, slipping about 0.3% to roughly where they traded before the release. On the surface, it looked like a shrug. Underneath, the story is a sharp earnings snapback, with basic earnings per share at US$0.85 and quarterly net income at US$3.02 million, both solid figures for a regional bank of this size.
